format: JSON subset of YAML 1.2; read with Python json without installing dependencies

historical_replay.coordinates: integer regular grid x,y in [0,29]; unitless simulation coordinates, not Fangshan metres
historical_replay.spatial_process: standardized gaussian_filter of iid N(0,1) field, sigma=3.0, mode=reflect
historical_replay.heterogeneity: five x bands via digitize(x,[6,12,18,24]); standardized [-1.3,0.7,-0.5,1.4,-0.3] template
historical_replay.response: conditionally independent Bernoulli(true_probability); intercept calibrated on known generating probabilities by 80 bisection steps on [-20,20]
historical_replay.noise: Bernoulli response noise; no separate measurement-noise amplitude in this inherited protocol
historical_replay.capture_meaning: fraction of probability signal retained by controlled oracle predictions; NOT observation thinning or inventory missingness
historical_replay.AUC_control: positive capture is an affine monotone transform of the same true probabilities, hence identical ranking/AUC; capture zero is constant score, AUC=0.5
historical_replay.historical_ratio: magnitude ratio; retain historical_theta_original_abs and historical_theta_centered separately from signed original R DSI formula
historical_replay.negative_controls: null response-generating scenario and capture=0 in every scenario
historical_replay.independent_prediction_status: oracle probabilities are specified from DGP without looking at the generated validation labels; these are construct-validity experiments, not trained-model forecast validation

new_design_LA_MDSI_extension.label: 新设计模拟扩展，不称原 LA-MDSI 模拟复现
new_design_LA_MDSI_extension.reason: Historical simulation does not contain train-only CART/K-means six combinations, R-DSI or S_theta
new_design_LA_MDSI_extension.spatial_blocks: 6x6 grid cells (25 complete blocks), inherited from existing six-cell band boundaries; this partition is newly specified
new_design_LA_MDSI_extension.strata_fit: CART and K-means fit on four covariates of training groups only; validation labels are not inputs
new_design_LA_MDSI_extension.graph_convention: legacy skip-nearest symmetric binary, matching empirical diagnostic estimand
new_design_LA_MDSI_extension.aggregation: fold Q25 / 1-IQR on six finite values, then equal-fold means; require all five folds valid, no silent partial mean
new_design_LA_MDSI_extension.identifiability: 199 response permutations per fold, four I tests and two q tests; ungated finite scores retained, gated summaries require all response tests in all folds
new_design_LA_MDSI_extension.reported_predictive_metrics: complete 900-observation oracle validation probabilities, identical for original DSI and LA-MDSI

monte_carlo_mean_CI.unit: independently generated DGP repetitions, paired captures retained in raw data

new_design_LA_MDSI_extension.known_target_interval_coverage: conditional Bernoulli prevalence normal interval based on known sum p(1-p), not invented true theta targets
new_design_LA_MDSI_extension.no_claim: No observed missingness model, constant-AUC classifier fitting, new external event validation, or known positive-capture population theta coverage
